title: Jesuitism
summary: JES'UITISM, noun The arts, principles and practices of the Jesuits. 1. Cunning, deceit; hypocrisy; prevarication; deceptive practices to effect a purpose. JES'UITS'-BARK, noun Peruvian bark; the bark
